decisive_passage: A1.1 **Change to payment period.** Section 6.3 of the Subcontract is amended by deleting the words "within ten (10) days after Contractor's receipt of Owner Payment" and replacing them with "within seven (7) days after Contractor's receipt of Owner Payment." As amended, Contractor shall pay each approved progress payment to Subcontractor, less retainage and any permitted withholding, within seven (7) days after Contractor receives payment from Owner for that work.
